title: B2B marketing Manager
description:
B2 B Marketing Manager

Manchester City Centre c.£50,000 + Career-Defining Growth Opportunity + a package that includes an EMI share option!

Build a Brand. Shape a Story. Drive Growth.

This is not a typical Marketing Manager opportunity.

It's a chance to become the first dedicated marketing hire in a high-growth consultancy that is disrupting a traditional professional services market and winning work that many established competitors would envy.

In just two years, this entrepreneurial business has built an impressive reputation, secured transformational client projects, assembled a talented team of specialists and grown to a position where it is on course to generate £seven figure revenue. All organically. All founder-led. All with a clear vision for what comes next.

Now, they're looking for a commercially-minded B2 B marketer to help accelerate that journey.

Working closely with the founder and leadership team, you'll take ownership of how the business is positioned, perceived and promoted. You'll work closely with the founder but have the freedom to shape the brand, influence strategy and build a modern marketing engine designed to support ambitious growth plans. Those plans will be accelerated in 2027 by the launch of their proprietary Ai driven SAAS tool which has been in beta development this year.

For a talented Marketing Executive ready for the next step, or an established Marketing Manager looking for greater influence and autonomy, this is a genuinely rare opportunity to make a visible impact.

The Opportunity

The business advises ambitious organisations undergoing transformation, helping leadership teams improve performance, implement new technology, redesign operating models and unlock efficiencies.

Their client portfolio includes:
- Fast-growing AI-enabled technology businesses
- Venture-backed software organisations
- Market-leading pharma companies
- PE-backed businesses undertaking transformation programmes
- Major organisations implementing ERP and business-critical software platforms

Their work sits at the intersection of business, technology and transformation. The challenge now is ensuring the market truly understands the value they create.

That's where you come in.

You'll be responsible for refining and elevating the company's brand presence, creating a clearer market proposition and building a compelling narrative that showcases both their expertise and culture.

What You'll Be Doing

Brand & Content
- Own and evolve the company brand and marketing strategy
- Refine messaging and positioning across all channels
- Create compelling content that brings client success stories to life
- Develop a distinct and consistent brand voice
- Ensure the business stands out in a crowded professional services market

Digital & Social
- Oversee the ongoing development of the website
- Improve user journeys and lead generation opportunities
- Shape the firm's social media presence, particularly LinkedIn
- Create engaging campaigns that drive awareness, engagement and credibility
- Leverage AI and marketing technology to improve efficiency and effectiveness

Events & Market Visibility
- Develop thought leadership campaigns
- Support events, roundtables and networking initiatives
- Increase visibility amongst senior decision-makers
- Create opportunities for the leadership team to showcase expertise and build relationships

Commercial Growth & Go-To-Market

This is where the opportunity becomes particularly exciting.

Alongside traditional marketing responsibilities, you'll play a key role in helping shape the company's go-to-market strategy.

You'll help develop processes, marketing automation, lead generation activities and commercial funnel management, ensuring marketing activity contributes directly to revenue growth.

For candidates who have experience building scalable marketing operations, commercial funnels or AI-enabled growth engines, there is scope for the role to evolve significantly.

What We're Looking For

We're interested in ambitious marketers who can combine creativity with commercial thinking.

You'll likely bring:
- B2 B marketing experience
- Exposure to professional services, technology, SaaS, software or consulting environments
- Strong content and storytelling capability
- Experience managing websites, social channels and digital campaigns
- A data-driven approach to decision making
- Commercial awareness and an understanding of how marketing contributes to revenue growth
- Curiosity around AI, automation and modern marketing technology

Most importantly, you'll be someone who enjoys building rather than maintaining.

You won't be inheriting a large team or significant budget.

You'll be creating, influencing, experimenting and making things happen.

Why Join?
- First dedicated marketing hire with genuine ownership and autonomy
- Direct access to an inspirational founder and leadership team
- Opportunity to shape a high-growth business at a pivotal stage in its journey
- Exposure to ambitious technology, SaaS, private equity and transformation projects
- Outstanding Manchester city-centre offices
- Fast-moving, entrepreneurial and highly collaborative culture
- Clear opportunity for progression into a future Head of Marketing or CMO-level position as the business scales

The Bottom Line

If you're looking for a role where you can genuinely influence a company's future, build a brand with purpose and help drive the next stage of growth for a business that's already proving its model, we'd love to hear from you.

This is the type of opportunity that rarely comes to market: high growth, founder-led, commercially successful and only just getting started.

title: Marketing Manager (Commercial)
description:
Marketing Manager, Commercial Property

Manchester, five days in the office with sensible flexibility, regular UK travel

Salary, £37,000 to £45,000 DOE

MCR Property Group is growing its commercial property portfolio and investing in the buildings, workspaces and teams behind it. Recent activity includes the acquisition of 4 M at Manchester Airport and Headrow House in Leeds, with further growth planned across offices, flexible workspace, industrial and mixed use assets.

We are now launching a new dedicated national commercial property brand, supported by a fresh dedicated marketing team focused entirely on the sector.

We are looking for a Marketing Manager to join that team and support the Head of Marketing, Commercial Property in building the brand, launching assets, generating demand and supporting leasing across the portfolio.

This is a hands-on, commercially focused role with the opportunity to join at the beginning, help shape how the new brand goes to market and play a direct part in building the marketing operation behind it.

The objective is simple: attract the right occupiers, generate more qualified enquiries and viewings, support agents and leasing teams, and help reduce the time that space sits empty.

The role

You will help manage the day to day marketing of our commercial portfolio, understanding what is available, who it is suitable for, what competing buildings are offering and how each asset should be positioned.

You will turn that understanding into campaigns across property portals, paid media, search, social, email, direct marketing, PR and agent communications.

You will support the launch of our new national commercial brand across websites, campaigns, signage, property marketing, occupier communications and new acquisitions.

You will also help establish the new dedicated commercial marketing team, working alongside the Head of Marketing as the function develops and grows.

You will have access to MCR Property Group's established in house studio, CRM team, digital specialists and wider marketing management resource, giving the new commercial team the capability to move quickly and deliver high quality work internally.

What you will be responsible for
- Managing day to day marketing plans across a portfolio of commercial properties
- Supporting the launch and growth of the new national commercial property brand
- Helping build the marketing processes, standards and ways of working for the new dedicated commercial team
- Delivering campaigns designed to generate qualified enquiries and property viewings
- Managing property listings, websites and landing pages, ensuring content, availability, imagery and enquiry routes are accurate and effective
- Supporting acquisition launches, refurbishment campaigns and asset repositioning
- Briefing photography, video, CGI, Matterport and other property content
- Working with the in house studio on brochures, presentations, signage, hoardings, digital creative and agent materials
- Working with the CRM team to improve lead capture, tracking, follow up and reporting
- Monitoring campaign performance, enquiry levels, viewing activity and lead quality
- Supporting paid search, paid social, email marketing and digital acquisition activity
- Coordinating agent campaigns, events, property updates and occupier communications
- Supporting PR around acquisitions, lettings, refurbishments and portfolio growth
- Managing external suppliers where required
- Supporting marketing budgets and ensuring spend is directed towards activity that produces results

Commercial focus

This is a marketing role that sits close to leasing.

We want someone who is interested in what happens after a campaign goes live.

Did it generate enquiries, were they the right enquiries, did they become viewings, did the viewings progress, what did the agents say, what should we change

You will regularly review enquiry levels, viewing activity, conversion, occupancy, campaign performance, agent feedback and marketing spend.

You do not need to be a surveyor, but you should want to understand the commercial side of property and the impact marketing has on leasing.

Every empty unit has a cost, your role is to help create demand around it.

About you

You will have strong marketing experience and be ready to take greater ownership of campaigns, assets and performance.

Your background may be in commercial property, real estate, workspace, placemaking, hospitality or another sector where marketing is used to generate demand for physical space.

You will be organised, commercially minded and confident managing multiple projects at once.

You will understand digital marketing, campaign management, content, CRM and lead generation.

You will have strong written communication skills and be comfortable briefing creative teams, photographers, agencies and suppliers.

You will be confident working with senior stakeholders and external agents, and comfortable looking at performance data and making decisions from it.

Most importantly, you will care about the outcome of the work, not simply whether the campaign was delivered.

What success looks like

Success will mean a strong launch for the new national commercial brand, more qualified enquiries, more property viewings, stronger digital conversion, better asset launches, improved agent engagement, clearer CRM data, better marketing materials and more efficient spend.

It will also mean helping establish a dedicated commercial marketing team that can scale with the portfolio and support the next stage of growth.

Working pattern

The role is based in Manchester and is primarily office based, five days a week, with sensible flexibility where required.

Regular travel across the UK portfolio is part of the role. You will visit properties, meet agents, work with site teams and understand local markets first hand.

Commercial property is a physical product, and the best marketing comes from understanding the buildings properly.

Why join
- This is an opportunity to join at the start of something new.
- A new dedicated

CENTRAL MANCHESTER, ANCOATS

title: Digital Experience Manager
description:
About The Role
At Domino's, your skills, ideas and judgement really matter. As our Digital Experience Manager, you'll shape and improve the customer journey across our app, website and Dom Central-powered systems.

From discovering the right deal to completing checkout, you'll help make every interaction intuitive, consistent and high-performing. You'll use customer insight, digital data and experimentation to identify what could work better, then bring Product, UX, Marketing, CRM, Operations and Technology teams together to deliver the change.

Based in Manchester, you'll also manage and develop one direct report, giving them the clarity, coaching and support they need to do great work.
What You'll Bring
You understand how customers behave online and what makes an end-to-end ecommerce journey work. You're comfortable moving between customer insight, commercial priorities and delivery, turning complex findings into clear recommendations that people can act on.
You'll bring:
- Experience improving digital customer journeys across websites, apps or other ecommerce platforms.
- A good understanding of ecommerce trading, including conversion, promotions, merchandising and onsite content.
- Practical knowledge of UX, conversion rate optimisation and test-and-learn approaches.
- The ability to interpret analytics, customer feedback and journey data to identify friction and prioritise improvements.
- Clear communication skills, with the confidence to influence Product, UX, Technology, Marketing, CRM and Operations teams.
- Strong organisation and attention to detail, particularly when managing campaigns, content, quality assurance and competing priorities.
- The ability to manage and develop a direct report through clear direction, coaching and constructive feedback.

A degree or professional qualification is not essential for this position.
What You'll Be Doing
You'll connect insight with action. That means understanding where customers encounter friction, working with the right teams to improve the experience and measuring whether the changes have delivered the intended result.
You'll:
- Optimise the digital customer journey: Use customer behaviour, feedback and performance data to improve journeys across app and web, from onboarding and menu exploration through to checkout and post-purchase interactions.
- Turn insight into better experiences: Work with Product, UX, Research, Data and Technology teams on experimentation, CRO and UX priorities, making sure customer discovery and testing inform delivery.
- Strengthen execution and performance: Oversee onsite campaigns, content and promotional activity; maintain accurate product information; track digital and customer-journey KPIs; and improve processes that prevent broken journeys or recurring errors.

You'll also contribute to the wider digital experience strategy, provide clear recommendations to senior stakeholders and help align teams around the improvements that matter most to customers and the business.
How We Will Support You
Bring your flavour, and we'll back your future. This role gives you the space to build your digital expertise, develop your leadership skills and influence work that reaches customers across Domino's digital channels.
Here's what you can expect:
- A clear induction, with the context and support you need to understand our digital ecosystem, priorities and ways of working.
- Support from your manager and the wider team, alongside the autonomy to use your judgement and shape how digital-experience improvements are delivered.
- Opportunities to broaden your strategic exposure by working across Product, UX, Data, Marketing, CRM, Operations and Technology.
- Support to grow as a people manager, helping you give clear direction, develop talent and create consistently high standards.
- Recognition for great work, from everyday appreciation to wider moments such as our Domi Awards.

Our employer brand is built around growth, belonging, recognition, wellbeing and giving people space to shape their role with support to succeed.

About The Company
Domino's UK & Ireland
Who are we? A forward-thinking, inclusive world's leading pizza company:
Domino's is the world's leading pizza company, with over 1,300 stores across the UK and Ireland. We're committed to using the freshest, highest-quality ingredients to create over 110 million delectable pizzas each year. Plus, we're a tech-savvy and data driven bunch - 90% of our system sales come through digital channels and 75% of our digital orders coming via the app we have 9.5 million active app customers!
Our mission? To be the go-to choice for food delivery and collection by crafting hot, freshly made pizzas that earn us accolades and the loyalty of millions of pizza enthusiasts worldwide. We're all about innovation, growth, and a commitment to excellence.
At Domino's, we embrace the power of diversity and foster an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered. We celebrate the uniqueness of each individual, regardless of their identity, background, or any other characteristic. When you join our team, you join a family that welcomes and celebrates authenticity!
Our recipe for success? Our DomiDNA:
- We Mean Business
- We Always Deliver
- We're Open to New Flavours
- We're Tastier Together

If you share our values and are ready to be part of a world-class team that's as passionate about people as we are about pizza, apply now and join the Domino's UK & Ireland family!

title: HubSpot Funnel & Conversion Marketing Manager - Travel Franchise
description:
Revenue Funnels HubSpot Sales Psychology Marketing Automation CRO

Great marketing doesn t just generate leads. It understands what makes people buy.

Why does someone click but not enquire? What makes a prospect book a call? What messaging builds trust, overcomes objections and turns curiosity into a buying decision?

And can you personally build a funnel that turns those insights into results?

We re The Travel Franchise, the UK s leading travel franchise, voted Best Lifestyle Franchise in the World two years running. We already generate thousands of enquiries every month. Now we need a commercially sharp, technically brilliant, hands-on funnel specialist to turn that interest into qualified opportunities and new franchise owners.

This isn t about building automations to a brief. It s about understanding the audience, developing the strategy, writing persuasive messaging, building the entire funnel and continually testing what works.

If you love the psychology of selling as much as the technology behind it, we d love to meet you.

The Role at a Glance

HubSpot Funnel & Conversion Marketing Manager
Remote - UK Bournemouth Preferred for Occasional Collaboration
Competitive Salary DOE + Bonus
Permanent Full Time

Pedigree: UK s Leading Travel Franchise Best Lifestyle Franchise in the World Two Years Running

Your Background / Skills: HubSpot (5+ Years), Revenue Funnels, Marketing Automation, Sales Copywriting, Direct Response Marketing, Sales Psychology, CRO, Lead Nurture, Landing Pages, WordPress, Elementor, A/B Testing

The Role a Year From Now

Your first year will have been a success if you ve delivered these three outcomes:

More qualified franchise opportunities: You ve improved how we convert existing interest into booked conversations, qualified enquiries and new franchise owners.

High-performing revenue funnels: You ve personally built sophisticated HubSpot funnels that guide prospects through a longer, considered buying journey with compelling messaging, intelligent automation and timely follow-up.

Measurable conversion improvements: You ve continually tested and refined landing pages, copy, campaigns and nurture sequences, using performance data to lift conversion and commercial results.

This Role

This is a genuinely hands-on, commercially focused funnel-building role. We re not looking for someone to manage HubSpot, oversee agencies or implement campaigns designed by somebody else. We need someone who can spot a commercial opportunity, understand the audience and independently work out how to turn interest into action.

Buying a travel franchise is a significant personal and financial decision. Prospects may spend weeks or months researching and weighing up their options. So the marketing journey needs to do far more than capture an email address: it must build trust, create desire, address objections and move people towards a conversation with our sales team.

You ll make that happen, from messaging and copy to landing pages, HubSpot workflows and conversion testing. Working closely with our marketing team and Co-Founders, you ll have the freedom to challenge assumptions and introduce new ideas.

What You ll Be Working On

Building complete revenue funnels: Designing and personally building multi-step HubSpot funnels that move prospects from initial interest to qualified sales opportunity.

Creating persuasive messaging: Writing landing-page copy, email sequences, headlines and CTAs that connect with the audience s motivations and buying psychology.

Understanding the buying journey: Identifying what prospects need to hear, see and experience at each stage of a high-value, longer-consideration sale.

Developing intelligent automations: Building complex workflows, behavioural triggers, segmentation, lead scoring and nurture sequences that respond to prospect intent.

Creating high-converting landing pages: Building and improving pages in WordPress and Elementor.

Testing and optimising relentlessly: Experimenting with messaging, offers, layouts, CTAs, timing and funnel structures to find what genuinely improves conversion.

Improving lead quality: Working with the sales team to understand which enquiries convert and where prospects drop off.

Personalising the experience: Using RightMessage, HubSpot and AI to deliver more relevant content and journeys.

Owning the results: Analysing funnel performance and making ongoing improvements based on qualified leads, booked calls and revenue opportunities.

Here s the Experience We re Looking For

You ll be an experienced, hands-on HubSpot specialist with strong commercial and creative instincts, bringing:
- 5+ years of substantial, hands-on HubSpot experience, confidently building sophisticated automations, workflows, funnels, segmentation, nurture sequences and reporting yourself.
- Proven experience building complex, high-converting sales funnels, ideally for high-value products or services with consultative buying journeys.
- Strong sales copywriting skills: compelling headlines, landing pages, email sequences and CTAs that persuade people to take the next step.
- A genuine understanding of sales psychology: motivations, objections, trust-building and persuasion.
- The ability to develop and execute your own ideas without someone mapping out every campaign.
- Extensive testing and optimisation experience, with examples of what your improvements delivered commercially.
- Confidence in creating landing pages and campaign assets yourself, ideally in WordPress and Elementor.
- Strong commercial awareness: you know the difference between generating leads and generating qualified opportunities that convert into revenue.
- Excellent written and spoken English.
- A proactive, hands-on approach: you re happiest getting into the platforms and making things happen.
- Experience with RightMessage, website personalisation, AI-driven marketing tools and integrations would be highly beneficial.

Most importantly, we want someone who can show us what they ve personally built, why they built it that way, how they improved it and what it achieved.

Why Join Us?

You ll own one of the most commercially important areas of our marketing, work directly with decision makers, have the freedom to experiment and see the commercial impact of your work.

Salary: Competitive, depending on experience.
Performance Bonus: Rewards linked to business performance.
Professional Development: Dedicated learning budget.
Holiday & Travel: Generous holiday allowance plus genuine travel opportunities.
Culture: Netflix-inspired Freedom & Responsibility context not control, outcomes over hours.

Who Are We?

Not Just Travel and The Travel Franchise are multi-award-winning travel companies with over 700 active Travel Consultants across the UK. Our unique B2 B2 C model lets franchisees build successful travel businesses, backed by our marketing, systems, training and infrastructure. Marketing plays a central role in connecting the right people with that opportunity.

If you love building sophisticated funnels, understand what makes people buy and get a buzz from improving conversion, we d love to hear from you.

Ready to Join Us?

Your data is processed by our talent partner RR (Recruitment Revolution) on the basis of their legitimate interests in fulfilling the recruitment process. Please refer to their Data Privacy Policy & Notice on their website for further details.

title: Marketing Associate
description:
On behalf of our client, a dynamic and fast-growing professional services group based in Salford Quays, we are seeking an ambitious, creative, and commercially driven Marketing Associate.

Our client operates across specialist consultancy sectors, including R&D Tax Relief and Mechanical & Electrical (M&E) consultancy. As they expand their footprint across the UK and launch targeted international growth initiatives (particularly into the US market), they are looking to hire a marketer who can take ownership of their brand presence and quickly step into a leadership role.

This is not a passive, social-media-only role. Our client wants someone who understands how strategic B2 B marketing builds credibility, drives engagement, and directly generates commercial business opportunities.

The Opportunity

Reporting directly to senior leadership, you will take ownership of the day-to-day creation, coordination, and execution of marketing activity across our client's business units.

Importantly, our client has designed this position with clear career progression in mind. They are looking for an individual with the talent and drive to progress into a Marketing Manager position, taking on increased responsibility for group-wide strategy, budget allocation, and future marketing hires as the business expands.

Key Responsibilities

1. Content Creation & Brand Development
- Produce engaging, commercially focused marketing content tailored to business owners, CFOs, and senior decision-makers.
- Write and coordinate articles, thought-leadership pieces, case studies, infographics, presentations, newsletters, and promotional collateral.
- Translate complex technical topics into accessible, compelling messaging.
- Maintain consistent brand identity, tone of voice, and corporate positioning across all channels.
- Work alongside internal technical experts to uncover client success stories and industry insights.

2. Social Media & Digital Marketing
- Take full ownership of our client's social media channels, with a strong focus on LinkedIn for B2 B engagement.
- Develop structured content calendars aligned with core commercial objectives.
- Plan and deploy targeted email marketing campaigns and digital outreach initiatives.
- Support website content management, SEO optimization, and inbound lead generation strategies.
- Track channel analytics and performance metrics to continually optimize output.

3. Omnichannel Marketing & Campaign Delivery
- Deliver integrated marketing campaigns across digital, social, email, and traditional print media.
- Coordinate the design and production of corporate literature, brochures, and event materials.
- Align marketing activity closely with sales and business development goals.
- Assist with event marketing, corporate communications, and strategic partnerships.

4. International Market Expansion
- Support the rollout of marketing campaigns aimed at US-based businesses and international partners.
- Research overseas market trends, audience personas, and competitive landscapes.
- Adapt content and brand messaging for foreign target markets.

5. Performance, Reporting & ROI
- Monitor and report on marketing performance, tracking KPIs like web traffic, engagement, and lead acquisition.
- Work closely with senior management to refine strategy based on campaign performance data.

Candidate Requirements

Our client is looking for a proactive marketer who combines creative execution with sharp commercial awareness.

Essential Criteria
- B2 B Experience: Demonstrable marketing experience within professional services, corporate consultancy, or service-based B2 B sectors.
- Content & Copywriting: Strong writing abilities with a knack for turning technical concepts into clear B2 B copy.
- Digital & Social Expertise: Hands-on experience using LinkedIn for B2 B lead generation, along with email marketing tools and digital campaigns.
- Omnichannel Delivery: Ability to manage campaigns across digital, email, design, and print formats.
- Design Capability: Experience producing visual content and marketing collateral using tools like Canva or Adobe Creative Suite.
- Commercial Mindset: Understanding of marketing analytics, ROI tracking, and how marketing fuels sales pipelines.
- Career Ambition: Clear desire to progress into a Marketing Manager role over time.

Desirable Criteria
- Prior experience or exposure to R&D Tax Relief, engineering, construction, M&E, or technical consultancy.
- Exposure to UK professional services or US market expansion initiatives.
- Familiarity with CRM systems, marketing automation, Google Analytics, SEO, or LinkedIn Campaign Manager.

Strategic Career Progression

Our client is committed to investing in your long-term growth through a defined multi-stage career path:
- Initial Phase (Marketing Associate): Establish a consistent marketing presence, master core messaging, and take charge of content delivery across all active channels.
- Development Phase (Strategic Ownership): Expand into campaign strategy, market research, brand positioning, and international expansion efforts.
- Leadership Phase (Marketing Manager): Step into a Marketing Manager role, taking full ownership of group marketing strategy, budgets, and team expansion.

Why Apply Through Us for This Role?
- Direct Access: Work closely with senior leadership without getting bogged down in corporate red tape.
- Multi-Sector Exposure: Broaden your portfolio across two high-demand, high-value consultancy sectors.
- Real Career Track: Join a company that actively wants to fast-track you into a management position.

How to Apply

Contact David at Greys Specialist Recruitment
